utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you being there Saturday on the front porch. That extra help means a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll be there Saturday on the front porch and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren, I’d appreciate that. Can you help on the front porch this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, yes — I can help on the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. Would you be able to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still lining up the helper list, but I can help if we keep the timing tight. What time are you planning for the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam, I’m still looking for a couple more helpers for Saturday on the front porch. Even a few hours would make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m happy to help for a few hours on Saturday. Just let me know what time you need me on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you help me out this Saturday on the front porch for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’m still organizing the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I could really use a few helpers. If you’re free, I’d be so grateful!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I’m still set for Saturday at the front porch. I’ll be there to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks, Vik. I’m happy to help too, and I can be there Saturday on the front porch once you have the time set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch. I can help out if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Oren. Thank you for offering.
